data.title: SAMA Licenses Izdihar Financing Company to Engage in SME Finance
data.content:
Riyadh, November 22, 2026, SPA -- The Saudi Central Bank (SAMA) has announced the licensing of Izdihar Financing Company to engage in small and medium enterprise (SME) finance, bringing the total number of finance companies licensed by SAMA to 80.
    The decision reflects SAMA's efforts to support and empower the finance sector, enhance the efficiency and flexibility of financial transactions, and encourage innovation in financial services to promote financial inclusion in the Kingdom and ensure access to financial services for all segments of society.
    SAMA emphasized the importance of dealing exclusively with financial institutions licensed or authorized by the central bank. The public can verify their status by visiting SAMA's official website.
    -- SPA
